conclusion: 今日主线是: Astra 把“能替你操作电脑”的模型能力推到了更高位，但真正可复用的不是一句“更强”，而是三张准入表: 模型准入、权限准入、发布准入。OpenAI 发布 GPT-6 Astra，并在安全概览中明确它对浏览、工作场景和 prompt injection 更稳，但也指出更强模型带来更高的 cyber 能力和更复杂的监控问题；Codex 0.153.1 已把 GPT-6-Astra 配置带进 API model catalog，但不改变默认模型或 model picker。GitHub 侧，Copilot 新增 Gemini 3.8 Flash、准备淘汰一批旧模型、恢复 Business/Enterprise 信用卡与 PayPal 注册，同时 Actions、CodeQL、npm trusted publishing 和 Copilot CLI 都在补权限、身份、供应链和本地网络边界。
excerpt: 2026-09-04 的重点是 Astra 模型准入、computer-use 权限边界、Codex model catalog 和 CI/发布供应链小票。
今天的判断很明确: 新模型上桌前先发工牌；能操作电脑前先划边界；能发布软件前先留小票。

signals.title: GPT-6 Astra: A new generation of intelligence
signals.author: OpenAI
signals.summary: OpenAI positions GPT-6 Astra as a stronger model for coding, science, cybersecurity, and computer-use workflows, making model admission and tool-permission gates more important than raw capability claims.
signals.takeaway: 动作: Create an Astra Model Admission Checklist before changing any default model: entry point, default state, tool scope, budget, fallback, and rollback.

signals.title: Safety overview: GPT-6 Astra
signals.author: OpenAI
signals.summary: OpenAI describes improved robustness around browsing, workplace tasks, and prompt injection, while also warning that stronger capability raises cyber and monitoring risks.
signals.takeaway: 动作: For computer-use agents, define allowed systems, forbidden actions, monitoring evidence, and human-stop conditions before granting tools.

signals.title: GPT-6 Astra model documentation
signals.author: OpenAI Developers
signals.summary: The model documentation is the operational reference for API availability, pricing, context, modalities, and endpoint support, which are separate from marketing launch language.
signals.takeaway: 动作: Treat developer docs as the source of truth for API integration; record model key, context, supported endpoints, and pricing in model receipts.

signals.title: Codex 0.153.1 adds API-configurable GPT-6-Astra without changing defaults
signals.author: OpenAI / GitHub
signals.summary: Codex can configure GPT-6-Astra through the API model catalog, but the release explicitly keeps the default model and model picker unchanged.
signals.takeaway: 动作: Separate model-catalog availability from default activation; keep alpha/model-catalog experiments outside the stable lane until local validation passes.

signals.title: Codex 0.154.0-alpha.3 continues the alpha lane
signals.author: OpenAI / GitHub
signals.summary: A newer alpha appears after the stable-facing 0.153.1 change, so release cadence is moving faster than stable operating guidance.
signals.takeaway: 动作: Track alpha releases for direction only; require fixed tasks, owner, rollback, and local evidence before promoting any alpha behavior.

signals.title: GitHub Copilot CLI 1.0.83-5 gates localhost access in sandbox
signals.author: GitHub / GitHub releases
signals.summary: The release notes say macOS and Linux sandboxes block access to locally running services by default, requiring explicit Allow local network for localhost testing.
signals.takeaway: 动作: Add a Localhost Sandbox Test Gate to any agent-driven dev-server, Playwright, or E2E task that needs 127.0.0.1 access.

signals.title: Gemini 3.8 Flash is available in GitHub Copilot public preview
signals.author: GitHub Changelog
signals.summary: GitHub continues to expand Copilot's model catalog, increasing the need to manage model selection, team defaults, and fallback rules instead of relying on a single provider mental model.
signals.takeaway: 动作: Maintain a team model directory with approved models, allowed surfaces, retention notes, and fallback order.

signals.title: Upcoming deprecation of selected GitHub Copilot models
signals.author: GitHub Changelog
signals.summary: Copilot model retirement means saved prompts, default settings, and automation receipts can drift even when local code does not change.
signals.takeaway: 动作: Audit automations and team defaults for deprecated model IDs; store replacement model, cutoff date, and rollback plan.

signals.title: Reopening Copilot Business and Enterprise signups
signals.author: GitHub Changelog
signals.summary: Credit-card and PayPal signups for Copilot Business and Enterprise reopen, so smaller teams can reach enterprise-style controls without sales-led onboarding.
signals.takeaway: 动作: For team trials, prepare access policy, budget, content exclusions, and default-model settings before enabling paid signup.

signals.title: GitHub Actions early September 2026 updates
signals.author: GitHub Changelog
signals.summary: Actions adds runner deprecation APIs, vulnerability-alerts read permission, and reusable workflow metadata in job context, improving CI provenance and least-privilege controls.
signals.takeaway: 动作: Record runner retirement, vulnerability-alert read scope, and reusable workflow provenance in CI release receipts.

signals.title: CodeQL 2.26.4 improves GitHub Actions security detections
signals.author: GitHub Changelog
signals.summary: CodeQL improves detection of mutable reusable workflow references and other Actions hardening issues, which directly affects agent-generated CI changes.
signals.takeaway: 动作: Require sha pinning or documented exceptions for third-party and cross-repository reusable workflows created by agents.

signals.title: Multiple trusted publishing configurations for npm
signals.author: GitHub Changelog
signals.summary: npm trusted publishing can now support multiple OIDC configurations for the same package, enabling stable, prerelease, and staging lanes without long-lived tokens.
signals.takeaway: 动作: Build a Staged Publishing OIDC Matrix and verify additive matching does not accidentally broaden publish rights.

signals.title: GitHub CLI Linux package signing key expires September 5
signals.author: GitHub Changelog
signals.summary: GitHub warns that the Linux package signing key expires on September 5, which can break CI images or developer hosts that install gh through package managers.
signals.takeaway: 动作: Check CI base images and developer setup scripts for gh key refresh before treating package-install failures as application failures.

signals.title: Supported AI models in GitHub Copilot
signals.author: GitHub Docs
signals.summary: The supported-models page is the durable readback point for which Copilot surfaces expose each model and what constraints apply.
signals.takeaway: 动作: Pair changelog reading with docs readback before changing team defaults or automation routing.

knowledge.title: Astra Model Admission Checklist
knowledge.summary: 把新旗舰模型接入当成一次受控变更，而不是简单切换默认模型。
steps: 记录 model key、入口、默认状态、是否在 picker 可见、上下文上限、价格和可用计划。
固定允许工具、允许数据、禁止动作、预算和 fallback 模型。
用一组固定任务做可重复验收，再决定是否进入默认 lane。
knowledge.risk: “能配置”不等于“已经默认启用”，更不等于“适合生产任务”。

knowledge.title: Computer-Use Permission Envelope
knowledge.summary: 给能操作浏览器、桌面或 CLI 的模型套一层动作边界信封。
steps: 写清允许读写的系统、路径、账号、仓库和外部服务。
明确禁止交易、删数据、改安全阀、读凭证、扩大连接器或绕过审批。
每个关键动作后做状态读回，异常时停止而不是补权限硬闯。
knowledge.risk: 高能力 agent 更容易把“完成目标”理解成“绕过阻碍”。

knowledge.title: Localhost Sandbox Test Gate
knowledge.summary: 把 sandbox 是否允许访问本机服务当成测试前置条件。
steps: 记录测试是否需要 localhost、端口和启动进程。
若 sandbox 默认阻断本机服务，先判断是边界失败还是应用失败。
只有必要时开启 local network，并记录原因与撤销条件。
knowledge.risk: 网络边界变化会伪装成测试回归。

knowledge.title: Reusable Workflow Provenance Receipt
knowledge.summary: 对 reusable workflow 记录实际执行来源，而不是只看调用方 workflow。
steps: 对第三方或跨仓库 reusable workflow 要求 sha pinning 或明确例外。
把 provenance 写入 CI artifact 或发布小票。
knowledge.risk: 没有来源小票时，审计只知道谁触发，不知道真正跑了哪份 workflow。

knowledge.title: Staged Publishing OIDC Matrix
knowledge.summary: 为同一个 npm 包配置多个 OIDC 发布入口，但默认只允许 staging，人审后再发布。
steps: 给每个配置记录 repository、workflow、environment、是否允许 direct publish。
默认 staged publishing；malware scan 完成前不开放批准。
检查配置是否重叠，因为匹配是 additive 且顺序不保证。
knowledge.risk: 多配置能减少长期 token，但配置重叠会扩大可发布面。
